program.name: Core Foundations
program.subject: Core & abs
program.blurb: Anti-extension, anti-rotation and carry days, each with a mobility flow and a little strength.
program.about: Core training done properly: resisting arching, resisting twisting, and carrying load. Each day pairs one of those themes with a mobility flow and a little strength. Level II slows every lowering to three seconds and Level III brings harder variations. A solid base for your back and for everything else you lift.
